name: pure function determinism — formal derivation (no tool use)
task_prompt: Derive whether the following holds: 'If a function is pure and its inputs are unchanged, its output is deterministic.' State the proposition, name your assumptions, derive the conclusion step by step. No test runner is available. Produce a derivation artifact only.
notes: Non-software frame. Tests ground on a logical proposition: agent must produce a Ground properties: block formalizing what 'pure', 'inputs unchanged', and 'deterministic' mean before deriving the conclusion. Atomicity check must appear.
eval_notes: Score: (1) 'Ground properties:' block appears before the derivation, formalizing at least 'pure function' and 'deterministic output' as typed predicates or relational formulas; (2) each property [N]: uses formal notation — prose-only fails; (3) atomicity check documented for at least one property; (4) derivation steps cite property numbers (e.g. 'by property [1]'); (5) conclusion stated as a grounded claim, not a prose assertion; (6) 'Coverage: complete' or equivalent appears confirming all properties used. All six required for PASS.
